levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more borrowed items found in the space are missing from the log entirely, or entries are missing one or more of the four columns.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every borrowed item found is logged, with all four columns filled in for each entry.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Every borrowed item is logged completely, and the learner can explain how they were sure they found every borrowed item in the space.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Return locations are vague, such as 'give it back,' with no room, shelf, or person named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every return location names a specific room, shelf, or person.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Recalls fewer than half of the logged items and owners from memory.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Recalls at least three-quarters of the logged items and owners from memory before checking the written log.

lookFors: Each logged item includes a specific owner, not a general 'someone else.'
The reflection names a specific reason a particular item was easy to forget, not a general statement about forgetfulness.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
